topics.label: Introduction to inflammation mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Principles of microbial and damage recognition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the molecular patterns that trigger innate immunity and explain the criteria used to differentiate foreign threats from self.

topics.label: Pattern recognition receptor families and intracellular signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the genetic basis, spatial distribution, and downstream signaling pathways of innate receptors that detect infection and cellular stress.

topics.label: Inflammatory cascade, leukocyte trafficking, and systemic effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how sentinel cell activation directs leukocyte recruitment, lymphatic drainage, and systemic outcomes of acute inflammation.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic containment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the body terminates acute inflammation, rebuilds damaged tissues, and establishes chronic structures like granulomas when threats persist.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic.
